categories.main_business_segments: Vats Liquor Chain Store Management Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the premium liquor marketing and service sector, focusing on the wholesale and retail distribution of high-end domestic and imported alcoholic beverages including baijiu, imported wines, and spirits. The company also develops and markets customized liquor products and operates a nationwide multi-channel sales network including chain stores, retail outlets, key accounts, group purchases, and e-commerce platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes product authenticity through a comprehensive anti-counterfeiting system involving source control, information technology management, and consumer supervision. It employs advanced technologies such as 3D printing, artificial intelligence, and big data analytics to support product customization and integrated online-offline sales. The supply chain is managed via an information system covering procurement, logistics, warehousing, and sales to ensure product traceability and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include chain retail platforms, large key accounts (KA), community convenience stores, and e-commerce consumers. The company serves a broad consumer base with a focus on middle and high-end consumers, including business and personal buyers. Major clients include large commercial groups such as Zhejiang Haochao Network Technology, Runjia Commercial (Shenzhen), and Metro Commercial Group. The company’s products cater to diverse consumer preferences across different regions and demographics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with significant presence in economically active and high-potential regions such as Hunan, Jiangsu, Beijing, Shandong, Guangdong, East China, South China, North China, Central China, Southwest, Northeast, and Northwest regions. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and maintains a nationwide logistics and warehouse network with over 40 warehouses covering major production and transportation hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Vats Liquor functions primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the liquor supply chain, acting as a key distributor and retailer linking upstream producers (liquor manufacturers) with end consumers. It operates wholesale distribution, retail chain stores, and e-commerce platforms, providing marketing, logistics, and after-sales services, thereby controlling significant parts of the distribution and retail process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding its chain store network and multi-format layouts, enhancing digital marketing capabilities, and deepening cooperation with premium liquor producers. R&D focuses on product selection, development of differentiated and customized products, and strengthening the product authenticity verification system. The company also invests in information technology projects to improve operational efficiency and customer experience, leveraging big data and AI for precise marketing and supply chain optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of liquor products including baijiu, imported wines, and spirits via wholesale and retail channels. The company also earns income from customized product development and e-commerce sales. Revenue streams include direct product sales to retail outlets, key accounts, and consumers, as well as service fees related to marketing and supply chain management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Vats Liquor is positioned as a leading premium liquor marketing and service provider in China and is the only listed company in the domestic liquor distribution sector on the A-share market. The industry is fragmented with few large dominant players, and the company faces competition from various market participants including traditional distributors and emerging e-commerce platforms. The company leverages its brand reputation, extensive channel network, and product authenticity system to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 9.46 billion, a 6.49% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 44.45 million, down 81.11% year-over-year. Despite revenue decline, operating cash flow improved by 54.23%. The company maintains substantial assets totaling over RMB 7.1 billion and continues to invest in expanding its retail network and digital capabilities. The brand value increased by 18% to RMB 32.07 billion, reflecting strong market recognition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Vats Liquor emphasizes premium, authentic, and high-quality liquor products with a strong commitment to product genuineness supported by a proprietary anti-counterfeiting system. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering various liquor categories and price segments, catering to diverse consumer preferences. Its integrated multi-channel marketing network and innovative retail formats provide consumers with a superior purchasing and tasting experience. The company’s brand reputation and service quality create strong customer loyalty and supply chain partnerships.
